purpose: Evaluate five unapproved GitLinq color candidates against the four existing registered product palettes.

method.coordinates: OKLCH (L and C on native 0..1 scale; h degrees), OKLab, and CIELAB D50
method.deltaEOK: Color.deltaE(other, "OK"): Euclidean distance in OKLab, the Cartesian form corresponding to OKLCH. Native scale; not multiplied by 100. No Euclidean distance is taken directly over polar L/C/h coordinates.
method.ciede2000: Color.deltaE(other, "2000"); default kL=1, kC=1, kH=1. Color.js CIELAB D50 conversion.
method.contrast: Color.contrast(background, "WCAG21") relative-luminance ratio, used with the existing design/WCAG 2.2 normal-text requirement of >=4.5:1; light #FFFFFF, dark #0D0F13.
method.matching: Each candidate role is compared only to the same role of all four existing products; front duplicates primary.light as in the supplied palettes. No invented aggregate average or color-distance pass threshold.

semanticContext.interpretation: primary.light comparisons share the current light-UI foreground context. primary.dark and mark.rear comparisons are cross-context information only, not direct UI-role collision decisions. DeltaE measures similarity, not semantic confusion probability.

visualReview.kind: Independent observation of root-provided Chromium screenshots; not a human-recognition experiment.
observations: Normal: orange resembles BookLinq and magenta resembles TraceLinq; cyan is adjacent to AskLinq teal.
Protanopia/deuteranopia: magenta approaches the VisionLinq/TraceLinq blue appearance; lime and orange approach BookLinq yellow/olive.
Tritanopia: cyan and AskLinq both appear very similar teal, while rose/orange approach the red semantic region.
Grayscale: all candidates and existing products lose hue identity; no unique color-only 16px recognition guarantee is justified.
visualReview.scopeLimit: Comparative visual observations, not universal perception guarantees or quantified CVD/16px pass results.

recommendation.reason: No candidate has yet demonstrated the full original all-active-products normal/grayscale/CVD 16px distinction gate. Relative color distance and AA results cannot replace semantic review, visible product names, and an accepted allocation record.
recommendation.priorityBasis: Of these five, cyan is less suggestive of deletion/error and addition/success in the normal UI and is a useful next candidate for application-context review; its AskLinq tritanopia similarity remains unresolved. This is not palette approval.

historicalEvidenceNote: This measurement and independent review preceded the final allocation. Its hold recommendation describes that earlier point in time; see the subsequent allocation record for the selected palette, revised context-based recognition gate, and unresolved limitations.
